errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос представлява стойностите, вариращи от 3,42 до 4,57,
errors.evidence: This describes the range of the data values on the bars, not the range of the vertical axis itself. The axis scale is not explicitly defined with a start and end point.
The vertical axis does not have any visible tick marks or labeled intervals. Stating that the intervals are 0.1 is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: За „Компютърна грамотност (основно ниво)“ син стълб е с височина 3,92, а оранжев – 4,08.
errors.evidence: The values for the category "Компютърна грамотност (основно ниво)" are 4.23 for the blue bar and 4.57 for the orange bar. The values 3.92 and 4.08 correspond to the category "Степен на техническа грамотност?".
The description omits reporting the data values for the category "Степен на техническа грамотност?" (Degree of technical literacy?). It incorrectly uses these values for another category.
The description fails to mention the main trend visible across all categories: the values for "Бизнес" (Business) are consistently higher than the values for "Студенти" (Students).
The description does not mention that there is a legend at the top of the chart that defines the colors for the two groups.
